# Compute all subset sums for left and right halves
def compute_sums(arr, mod):
    res = []
    total = len(arr)
    for mask in range(1 << total):
        s = 0
        for i in range(total):
            if mask & (1 << i):
                s += arr[i]
        res.append(s % mod)
    return res
